audit.whatIsWrong: Lane-difficulty prose treated Karma as a burst combo champion ('his combo chunks', 'while his combo is loaded') and misgendered her throughout.
audit.why: Karma's kit is one damage spell (Inner Flame, 9/8/7/6/5s, 950 range) plus Mantra empowerment; she is a poke-and-shield laner, not a burst combo. Difficulty is genuinely even (50.81% over 1293 games): she wins the level 1-2 range war, Cassiopeia wins from level 4 on.
audit.corrected: Reframed the early lane as a range deficit (950 vs 850) and the mid/late as a sustained-DPS win once Mantra is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: phases[0..4].side and phases[6].side all read 'Skill' while win[0..6] read Karma/Karma/Skill/Cassiopeia x4, matching the packet levelChart.
audit.why: The content layer and the packet agree with each other and with the kit: Karma's 950-range Q and free level-1 Mantra own levels 1-2; Cassiopeia's Q-poison into Twin Fang out-damages a single 5-9s cooldown from level 4. The full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0].side and phases[1].side to Karma, phases[3].side, phases[4].side and phases[6].side to Cassiopeia, and rewrote each why to match the new verdict. win[N] already holds these exact values on disk, so no content-layer chart edit is possible (before would equal after) — the pair is already in agreement after these edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1], early and wants.foe[1] attributed Karma's root to 'RQ'. Mantra-Q is the delayed cataclysm; the root is Focused Resolve (W), and Mantra-W extends it and heals her.
audit.why: Riot text: Q Mantra Bonus creates 'a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay'; W creates the tether that roots, and its Mantra Bonus heals Karma and extends the root.
audit.corrected: Named Focused Resolve (W, 12s flat, 675 range) as the root/gank setup and Mantra-Q as the cataclysm. Also added the anti-heal note from missingInteractions: Mantra-W heals her through an extended Twin Fang stream, so Oblivion Orb timing decides long fights. Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing you — she must be stepping up, not retreating.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve 12s flat, Inner Flame 9s to 5s, Mantra 40/38/36/34, Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).

audit.corrected: Replaced both with content matching their titles, grounded in Petrifying Gaze's facing requirement and Twin Fang's poison prerequisite.

edits.before: Karma out-ranges and out-sustains you in the poke war at levels 1-2 thanks to cheap Q spam and mana efficiency, so avoid trading Q for Q in neutral positions. Farm with Q only when she's used hers, and watch for RQ giving her a root that can set up a jungler gank on your immobile self. Don't waste Miasma early just to threaten trades — save it to punish her when she pushes past minions to poke.
edits.after: Karma out-ranges you 950 to 850 in the poke war at levels 1-2 with Inner Flame on a 9-second cooldown, so avoid trading Q for Q in neutral positions. Farm with Q only when she's used hers, and watch for Focused Resolve rooting you for a jungler gank on your immobile self. Don't waste Miasma early just to threaten trades — save it to punish her when she steps past minions to poke.

edits.before: Use RQ root to set up jungler ganks

edits.before: Her R-shield (RW) lets her tank a full combo and disengage, but your R lands a much bigger stun-punish window if she overextends her poke.
edits.after: Mantra-E shields her through your burst and Mantra-W heals her mid-tether, so bait Mantra out — it is 40 seconds at rank 1 and your R punishes the gap.
